reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited paragraphs support it: 14.1 vests Customer Data, Customer Confidential Information and pre-existing/independently developed IP in Customer with only a limited processing right to Vendor; 14.2 gives Customer ownership of Deliverables with a present assignment from Vendor plus personnel assignments; 14.3 limits Vendor retention to Vendor Technology and routes embedded Vendor Technology through the perpetual licence in 13.2; 14.4 bars joint ownership absent a signed instrument and preserves Customer's feedback rights.

No assignment of Customer IP or Customer Data to Vendor, no Vendor-owned deliverables without licence-back, and no joint ownership — none of the walk-away triggers are present, so the preferred position is met.
Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline text was changed and no counterparty comment was raised; the deterministic check ('no assignment of Customer Data/IP to Vendor remains') passes.

Rationale appropriately notes the payment condition in 14.2 and the anonymized telemetry carve-out in the Customer Data definition as awareness items rather than escalating them to deviations, which matches the playbook's treatment of minor sub-elements.
